Dear Enterprise Client 11,

Thank you for contacting us regarding the intermittent 500 Internal Server Errors you are experiencing with our API webhook. We understand how critical reliable webhook functionality is for your operations, and we appreciate you bringing this to our attention.

To investigate the root cause, we need some additional diagnostic information. Please provide the following details at your earliest convenience:

- Exact timestamps (UTC) of each failed webhook call.
- Full request payloads and HTTP headers for the failing calls, including any request IDs.
- Any client‑side logs or error messages that correspond with the 500 responses.
- Confirmation of the authentication token used (expiry date and renewal status).
- Details of any recent changes to the webhook configuration or deployment that might coincide with the failures.

You can securely upload the requested logs and data using our encrypted upload portal here: [Secure Upload Link].

Once we receive the information, we will forward the case to our API Engineering (Tier‑2) team for a deep analysis. Our goal is to resolve the issue within the 2‑business‑day resolution target for high‑urgency technical failures.

We will keep you updated on the progress and will change the ticket status to “Awaiting Customer Information” until we have the required data.

Thank you for your cooperation and patience.

Best regards,
Customer Support Team
